cohort: 71,799 women with singleton pregnancies in Japan between 2011 and 2014 from the Japan Environment and Children's Study.
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was significantly associated with increased fetal acidosis in overweight women and in women whose pre-pregnancy BMI was 23.0-25.0 kg/m2, especially in those with vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was significantly associated with increased fetal acidosis in women with vaginal deliveries, but not in those with caesarean deliveries.
